reasonToGo: The only ground both towns reach in a day and neither can hold, which is why four seasons of what either army carried is still lying on it.

hazards.name: No water on it
hazards.description: Rain sinks and comes back alkaline. A party crossing carries every drop it drinks.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: design claim C3's own worked example. Thirst is what this ground does, and the runtime enum has no value for it.

hazards.name: No cover for a day's crossing
hazards.description: Level, treeless and pale from edge to edge. Whatever steps onto it can be seen from the moment it steps on.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: being visible for a full day is not a tick.

hazards.name: The alkali dust
hazards.description: Wind lifts the flat and lays it grey on everything. It takes the eyes first and then the skin at the collar and the cuffs.

resources.name: Abandoned arms
resources.description: Shields, plate and burial stones left where they fell through four seasons of fighting, and never carried off by either side.

resources.name: The southern lip loam
resources.description: The one settled edge of the flat, marked and grassed over, with loam deep enough to turn.

landmarks.name: The grave rows
landmarks.description: Straight lines of marked stones running across the flat, laid in three ages and none of them finished.

landmarks.name: The abandoned cut lines
landmarks.description: Trench works both towns dug and neither held, filling with dust a hand's depth a year.
